title: Zainab Teray Baba Ki Jabeen Khon
body:
Zainab teray baba ki jabeen khon main tar hai
haider kay alamdar-e-husaini pay nazar hai
1- zainbab kay khullay sar pay hai haider ki nigahain
Yaad anay lagin sham kay bazar ki rahain
aikisiween ramazan ki honay ko sahar hai
2- Shabbair ka dharas has yeh zainab ka bharam hai
Rutba hai yeh ghazi ka kay saqaye haram hai
Dil band hai sarwar ka haider ka jigar hai
3- Soocho tu musalmano kay yeh baat bari hai
haq mangnay zehra saray darbaar khari hai
aye ghairat-e-islam bata, aaj kidher hai
4- woh waqt bhi hoogo kay koi paar na hoga
ghar baar luttay ga magar Abbas na hoga
aur jaye gee bazar ussay, yeh bhi khabar hai
5- ais gham ki muhafiz hain muhib zainab-e-dilgeer
duniya main jo baqi hai azadari-e-Shabbir
yeh fatima zehra ki, duaon ka asar hai
